verdict.rationale: Ubuntu Desktop's docs list AT-SPI D-Bus interfaces (org.a11y.atspi.Accessible, org.a11y.atspi.Action), which expose UI elements and actions programmatically, and the docs also cover the Linux command line. This is only a bare listing: nothing shows that every UI action is reachable through an API. missing for 10: documentation that all UI functionality is exposed via an API, any described API/CLI coverage of settings and apps, hands-on or independent corroboration of API parity.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
